label: Proposed/Recommended475; integrated Temporal handoff; application checks UNEXECUTED

rows.field_or_resource: Organizations, users, workspace memberships, service accounts and delegation grants
rows.projection: Temporal sees opaque run/scope/actor references only; clients see authorized safe projections
rows.transaction_and_guard: Session validity at acceptance/control only; durable run grant and current effect policy at dispatch, independent of logout/session expiry.
rows.disagreement_recovery: Explicit principal/run-grant or membership/service/connection/approval revocation stops future effects; immutable attribution retained. Restricted read-only reconciliation continues without new mutation permission.

rows.field_or_resource: Connection, provider-account witness and credential versions/ciphertext
rows.authority: PM PostgreSQL plus operator-owned wrapping-key service
rows.projection: No raw provider secret in public DTO, workflow input/history/search attributes/heartbeat/error
rows.transaction_and_guard: Scope and account revalidated before signer resolution; CAS refresh version and distributed lock/lease
rows.disagreement_recovery: Refresh loss may require reauthorization; alias connections share account coordination identity

rows.field_or_resource: Immutable RunSpec, complete action set, profile/flow/workset/schema bindings and submission key
rows.projection: Temporal workflow coordinates by PM run ID and immutable safe refs, never copies bulk intent
rows.transaction_and_guard: Acceptance TX inserts RunSpec, admission reservation, outbox, audit/events before202
rows.disagreement_recovery: Lost response dedupes same scope/key/hash; changed hash409; workflow outage leaves durable pending handoff visible

rows.field_or_resource: Workflow/activity schedule, durable timers, retry state and workflow history
rows.projection: PM API read model tracks workflow binding/observed orchestration status with observation timestamp
rows.transaction_and_guard: Deterministic workflows; all external I/O in activities; bounded metadata reads may remain synchronous in API
rows.disagreement_recovery: Workflow retry/replay cannot rewrite PM effect truth; missing/expired history is explicit repair condition

rows.field_or_resource: Physical dispatch intent, member identities, attempts, effects and exact acknowledgement/readback
rows.projection: Temporal carries safe receipt IDs/dispositions, not request bodies or provider tokens
rows.transaction_and_guard: Persist exact dispatch/member intent and reserve capacity before I/O; settle per member with CAS/fence
rows.disagreement_recovery: Remote acceptance without durable ack => unknown; fences block stale commits, cannot unsend external requests

rows.field_or_resource: Run state, task/member counters, results and terminal effect classification
rows.projection: Temporal status is an orchestration observation, not proof of remote effects
rows.transaction_and_guard: Reducer gives unknown/reconciling precedence; blocked task reason and cancel_requested are separate
rows.disagreement_recovery: Temporal completion without final PM projection remains projection_pending; reconcile from PM receipts, never infer success from workflow closed

rows.field_or_resource: Admission outbox, workflow start binding and schedule mutation desired/applied revision
rows.projection: Temporal owns actual workflow/schedule object; API exposes desired/applied lag
rows.transaction_and_guard: API-origin stable StartRun outbox; schedule-origin EnsureWorkflowBinding outbox. Schedule updates use Describe conflict token plus persistent exact-payload RequestId; rebase changes dispatch identity.
rows.disagreement_recovery: No atomic PG/Temporal transaction claim; retry same start, distinguish running/closed/absent/history-retained; never restart closed effect scope blindly

rows.field_or_resource: Schedule desired configuration, grants, revisions and occurrence admission ledger
rows.projection: Temporal owns schedule triggering and timer execution; PM stores intent and accepted occurrence/effect policy
rows.transaction_and_guard: Temporal schedule workflow first admits occurrence with PG RunSpec/budget/audit/binding-outbox. Uniqueness is schedule ID plus nominal UTC instant; adopt actual execution, never duplicate StartRun. Explicit 1h catchup, SKIP across actual run, DOM/DOW AND and both DST folds.
rows.disagreement_recovery: PM does not run a competing cron loop; stale trigger revision is blocked explicitly rather than rebound to latest flow

rows.field_or_resource: Provider-account concurrency/rate reservations across aliases and worker replicas
rows.projection: Temporal task-queue fairness/throughput complements account permits; clients cannot set provider rate keys
rows.transaction_and_guard: Atomic account permit/token reservation, short expiry and durable retry eligibility; scope-derived canonical account identity
rows.disagreement_recovery: A per-process limiter is only an additional cap; queue limits do not imply global account limits; unknown effects retain relevant budgets

rows.field_or_resource: Immutable artifact bytes, Parquet segments and sealed worksets
rows.projection: Worker scratch files are disposable; clients use scoped PM artifact API; Temporal stores refs only
rows.transaction_and_guard: Complete bounded upload, verify hash/length/version, then PG registers object/manifest revision and cursor
rows.disagreement_recovery: Object success before PG failure leaves an orphan; PG never references partial bytes; no filesystem rename/cross-storage atomicity fiction

rows.field_or_resource: Dataset manifest revisions, exact segment sets, snapshots and cursors
rows.projection: Query workers open only registered immutable objects; no shared writable DuckDB file
rows.transaction_and_guard: Manifest/cursor/ack transaction under scope and CAS/fence; empty publication gets generation witness
rows.disagreement_recovery: Compaction publishes new immutable objects then CAS manifest; GC uses snapshot/plan/proof/backup reachability and retention

rows.field_or_resource: Ephemeral query compute, download buffers and worker scratch
rows.projection: Not a recovery authority or shared writable database
rows.transaction_and_guard: Bound memory/disk/rows/time; reconstruct from registered object snapshot
rows.disagreement_recovery: Worker death discards scratch, not accepted intent or committed data; retries use same snapshot

rows.field_or_resource: Safe event history, audit and SSE sequence/snapshot
rows.projection: SSE notifications and telemetry are hints; CLI/UI use same durable sequence API
rows.transaction_and_guard: State/effect/receipt/audit/event commit together; scoped cursor, retention gap and consistent snapshot
rows.disagreement_recovery: Any API replica can replay; local bus loss cannot lose history; client disappearance does not cancel run

rows.field_or_resource: Catalog bundle and foundation implementation availability
rows.authority: Immutable release bundle plus actual worker handler registrations
rows.projection: Safe CLI/UI projections derive from installed revision and compatible registered worker build
rows.transaction_and_guard: One actual handler registry; version closure and real reachability gates; Atlas/proof not runtime authorities
rows.disagreement_recovery: Missing worker capability blocks dependent cell; descriptor alone cannot advertise implemented execution

rows.field_or_resource: Discovered account schemas and active snapshot selection
rows.projection: Public typed safe schema; provider credentials/private origins excluded
rows.transaction_and_guard: Candidate completeness/content fingerprint/account scope, If-Match promotion and immutable accepted bindings
rows.disagreement_recovery: Relevant drift blocks new effects; partial capture cannot replace complete; unrelated fields do not invalidate unused bindings

rows.authority: Versioned strict operator configuration and release manifest
rows.projection: Same selected backend stack in dev, one host and many hosts; endpoints/replicas differ
rows.transaction_and_guard: Explicit operator launcher/provisioning; no HTTP/CLI private DB or workflow autostart
rows.disagreement_recovery: Missing dependency yields safe readiness/degraded policy; no hidden SQLite/in-memory/local product fallback

rows.field_or_resource: Backup recovery epoch, restore manifest and dispatch quarantine
rows.authority: PM PostgreSQL plus coordinated Temporal/object/key backups
rows.projection: Temporal internal persistence tables remain Temporal-owned; PM never repairs them directly
rows.transaction_and_guard: Restore components at explicit consistent checkpoints; verify references and retain uncertain effect intents
rows.disagreement_recovery: Stale restoration can lose evidence of real effects: quarantine post-backup dispatch window and reconcile before writes, never claim rollback undid providers

authority_rule: Field authority wins; a projection never silently overwrites canonical external-effect truth. No two-system atomicity claim.
settled_stack: thin CLI and equivalent UI API
